findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done — The pinned pytest-rerunfailures 16.4 can rerun a test whose fixture teardown fails, but it leaves the first failure reported as an error even if the retry passes. The maintainers fixed this in [16.7](https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest-rerunfailures/blob/master/CHANGES.rst#167-2026-09-17). This suite has an autouse teardown that can fail at `tests/conftest.py:293-300`; the new retry proof covers setup and test-body failures only (`tests/test_windows_suite_retries.py:18-45`). A transient teardown failure therefore still leaves the Windows run red after a passing retry.
findings.title: Not done: Windows full-suite retries leave transient teardown errors red

why: Windows full-suite runs fail a different slow test each run (timeouts, a flaky retry), so the nightly is red even when nothing is broken
